instructions.name: execute
docs: Requirement #1. Not reachable via Anchor's normal instruction
dispatch — Token-2022 invokes this with the raw SPL
spl-transfer-hook-interface `Execute` discriminator, not Anchor's own
generated one, so it's only ever reached through `fallback` below.
Written as a normal-looking Anchor instruction anyway so the account
struct still gets Anchor's usual validation/deserialization.

accounts.name: owner
docs: deliberately *not* constrained to `source_token`'s owner via `token::authority`
here. Token-2022 itself already verified this account is a legitimate signer
(either the real owner or an approved delegate) before ever CPI-ing into this
hook, so re-asserting owner-equality here would just reject the common,
standard case of a delegated transfer (e.g. `tfe_exchange`'s own order-matching
model, where traders approve `tfe_exchange`'s PDA as delegate rather than
transferring out of their own accounts — see that program's README for why).
The KYC checks below are correctly keyed off `source_token.owner`/
`destination_token.owner` regardless — the real owner, never the delegate —
so this account's only real role is calling-program introspection.

accounts.name: extra_account_meta_list
docs: looks this account up at this exact PDA before invoking us.

accounts.name: instructions_sysvar
docs: Used to look up the top-level instruction that ultimately triggered
this transfer (requirement #2).

accounts.name: kyc_registry_program
docs: ID. Only used as the owning-program reference for the two KYC PDAs
below — never read.

accounts.name: sender_kyc_record
docs: manually in the handler per the documented layout in constants.rs
(see the comment there for why this isn't a typed Anchor `Account`).

instructions.name: initialize_extra_account_meta_list
docs: Requirement #5.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The mint authority — also pays for the validation account's rent.
Requiring this to be the real mint authority (via `mint::authority`
below) means only whoever controls the mint can wire up this hook's
extra-account config for it.

accounts.name: extra_account_meta_list
docs: `ExtraAccountMetaList::init` below, not an Anchor-serialized account.
Seeds match `spl_transfer_hook_interface::collect_extra_account_metas_seeds`
exactly — this is the fixed address Token-2022 itself looks up.

accounts.name: kyc_registry_program
docs: ID; only used here as the external "owning program" reference for
deriving the sender/receiver KYC PDAs in the extra-account-meta list.
